title: El Escudo Guayanés: El ecosistema más antiguo y los colosos tepuyes
goal: Examine the geomorphology of the Guiana Shield, the isolated ecology of tepuis (table-top mountains), and indigenous environmental guardianship.
grammar: Ecosistemas del Escudo Guayanés y tepuyes

sections.title: Unit 9: The Guianas & Belize — Lesson 2
body: Welcome to lesson 2 of Unit 9 in the Latin American Regional Studies track: Belize, Suriname & The Guianas: Multilingual Frontiers.
In this lesson, we study el escudo guayanés: el ecosistema más antiguo y los colosos tepuyes, evaluating physical geomorphology, maroon resistance, linguistic pluralism, and geopolitics.

items: Examine the geomorphology of the Guiana Shield, the isolated ecology of tepuis (table-top mountains), and indigenous environmental guardianship.
Master the lexicon and discourse of escudo-guayanes-tepuis-biodiversidad.
